set/private/same green and fd-number reuse fixed (bound_relocate_lowest lowest-free fix). Residual is architectural: a bound-volume fd carries a /dev/null-ish native SHADOW at the guest number while the real object is a host_handle; the SELF view (/proc/self/fd) resolves via the engine's g_fdpath, but the PEER view (parent live-inspecting /proc/<child>/fd) reads the child's real shadow fd. Making them agree AND show the true path needs the bound shadow to back the real file, or the fd->path to live in the shared fdvis arena (cross-process). Carrying g_fdpath on bound dup fixes SELF but then diverges from PEER (regresses set). Deferred pending shared-path vfd identity.
